name: The Scales of Gildrose
source:
Years and years of terrible dreams haunt you as long as you can remember. After a sleepless night and a long conversation with your mother, you finally get a reason: your father, a man who has remained a mystery to you all your life, is not human. It's time to go visit him and meet a whole new side of yourself you never expected.

[Edited from [url=https://niteowlstudios.itch.io/the-scales-of-gildrose]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从你记事起，年复一年的可怕梦境就一直困扰着你。经过一个不眠之夜和与母亲的长谈之后，你终于得到了一个理由：你的父亲，一个对你来说一生都是谜的人，不是人。是时候去拜访他并认识你从未预料到的全新一面了。

[编辑自[url=https://niteowlstudios.itch.io/the-scales-of-gildrose]itch.io[/url]]
